content: The function Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask shall set the out parameter DTCStatusMask to the value configured in DemDtcSta- tusAvailabilityMask of the DemEventMemorySet for the assigned client ID.

If the function Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask is called, the Dem shall provide the supported DTCStatusAvailabilityMask in the out pa- rameter DTCStatusMask and return E_OK. The DTCStatusAvailabilityMask is derived from DemDtcStatusAvailabilityMask and provided for primary fault memory as for user defined fault memories.
The function Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask shall set the out parameter DTCStatusMask to the value configured in DemDtcSta- tusAvailabilityMask of the DemEventMemorySet for the assigned client ID.
